toolArguments.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction. EXACT-POSITION LOCAL RECEIVER MASK S2 for Umiri neutral night. Input1 is the personally inspected original-color source with deliberate PURE-WHITE S1 paint on actual support contacts. Input2 is that exact clean approved mother only to distinguish intentionally painted white from naturally pale linen. Full1536x1024, preserve every marked source coordinate, no shift/crop/resize/re-pose.
Turn ONLY intentionally ADDED PURE-WHITE S1 marks into WHITE receiver cores: tiny original cushion contacts UNDER the real lower skirt hem and UNDER the side supporting palm/fingers, plus complete original toe/forefoot/sole/heel wood-contact footprints DIRECTLY BENEATH BOTH COMPLETE boots. Keep the marked real full sole-to-floor contact from front toe to rear heel in position. This must restore ground BELOW the actual boots, not float by shin or on the boot uppers. Preserve source contact footprint core and a SHORT SOFT GRAY outer fade over the actual source-connected diffuse shadow immediately outside that core, typically6..14source pixels only where real shade touches. Not just2px sole contour, not a new oval or expanded floor pool. Shoe interiors themselves black; tiny natural sole-edge overlap can merge with F.
EVERY OTHER pixel becomes solid PURE BLACK: all girl/hair/face/choker/jacket/red top/skirt/hands/whole book/legs/boot shafts/laces/toes/soles except tiny marked-boundary overlap, all UNMARKED cushion/curtains/lamp/knit/pillows/furniture/room/wood/rug and unrelated shadows/reflections. NO white figure contour or original highlight edges. Entire head/upper body/all pixels ABOVE y540 pure BLACK. Added receiver marks exist only near actual skirt/palm contact around y555..605 and original boot ground around y875..937, not higher-floating contact positions. These are inspection guides, never boxes to fill. No empty left bench stripe, no naturally bright cushion selection, no source RGB texture outside the true patches.
Output one opaque BLACK/WHITE/softedgeGRAY 1536x1024 mask, same exact source positions, no colors/checkerboard/text/UI/grid. It merges by MAX(L(F),L(S)) and selects original mother RGB once at FIXED source position, travel/slope/perspective0. NO independent caster or matte translation.
